headline: Osia Hyper Retail Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process; 3rd CoC meeting disclosed
sum: Osia Hyper Retail Limited, a NSE-listed retail entity, has been admitted into CIRP under the IBC 2016, with the 3rd Committee of Creditors meeting disclosed to the exchange as of 22 June 2026.
detail: Osia Hyper Retail Limited filed a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process disclosure with NSE on 22 June 2026, disclosing the 3rd Committee of Creditors meeting. The admission to CIRP was initiated under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company is listed on the NSE and is classified in the Consumer & Retail sector. The proceeding appears to be in the active resolution phase with multiple CoC meetings convened.
